mechanism: This is an evidence variant of the existing irreversible cooking state chain. Lock one original clearly adult cook, one kitchen, one dough or base, one tray and visible hand or tool anchors. Move through at least five irreversible food states, one operation per beat, while preserving outline, topping distribution, residue and container continuity. Oven or heat transitions must return the same tray and a plausibly changed version of the same item. End with the same serving and one restrained taste by the same adult. Do not copy source woman, kitchen, pizza, ingredients, recipe, lighting, camera or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock one clearly adult original cook, one base material, tray, kitchen and hand anchors.

Return the same tray after heat with plausible color, volume and texture change.

invariants.rule: End with the same serving and one restrained taste by the same adult.
